sarah ng: Heads up — urgent offer exception. Senior Infrastructure Engineer (UK) asking for temporary compband bump + start before payroll window. Need ppl-ops + comp + finance alignment.

sarah ng: Offer snapshot:
```
Base: GBP 120,000
Sign-on: GBP 8,000 one-time
Requested start: 2026-04-06
Requested provisional compband: Band 5D -> 5E (6 months)
Employment entity: Redwood UK LLP
```

diego mendez: Quick Qs: is candidate inside UK tax residence? Any immigration support required?

sarah ng: UK resident, no sponsorship. Hiring manager wants benefits active from day 1 for retention. Payroll says next payroll cutoff is 2026-04-15 so they can't onboard payroll on 04/06.

laura ivanov: Typically we either delay benefits until payroll or do a one-off provisional payment + backdate benefits if enrolled before cutoff. For compband uplifts we need comp committee + finance OK for temporary uplift.

tom wu: Manager sign-off: I approve the provisional uplift for 6 months and will reconvene at month 5 for retention review. Happy for sign-on to be paid on first available payroll.

people-ops-bot: Routing to comp-committee: "Provisional Band Uplift". Please attach manager justification and rollback plan.

diego mendez: @laura can finance confirm whether provisional payroll top-up is doable and what GL code to use? Also need employer NI estimate and withholding approach.

laura ivanov: Finance note — we need: gross vs net approach, whether to gross-up the provisional payment, employer NI impact, and a one-off tax withholding calc. If payroll processes on 04/15 we can backdate benefits to 04/06 provided enrollment paperwork is completed before cutoff.

sarah ng: Uploaded manager justification and retention clause draft: https://redwood.share/people-ops/docs/offer-note-3897654321 (private).

tom wu: I'll add the retention clause into the offer amendment and confirm rollback at month 6 if objectives not met.

diego mendez: Can comp-committee triage tomorrow (04/02)? Candidate requested decision by EOD Friday.

laura ivanov: We can add to comp agenda. If approved, payroll will schedule provisional payment on 04/15 and benefits enrollment can be backdated. Need confirmation from HR that enrollment forms are signed prior to cutoff.

sarah ng: Thanks all — will draft 1-pager and ping committee. :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Action items: [Sarah] 1-pager + link, [Diego] tax/withholding note, [Laura] GL code & NI calc, [Comp Committee] decide 04/02.
